notes.currency: Points (EPA) above a replacement-level player at the same position: the 20th-percentile rate among the position's regulars, times the player's volume.
notes.ol: Offensive linemen are not valued individually: public data have no blocking assignments, and on-field plus-minus cannot separate five linemen who play every snap together. Teams are graded on pass protection as a unit.
notes.defence: Defenders are valued on Splash EPA: the plays the box score credits them with (sacks, interceptions, forced fumbles, passes defensed, tackles for loss). Coverage, pressure without a hit and run fits are invisible, so defensive values are a floor on what a player is worth.
notes.trend: Trend: this season's Gridiron Value per game minus last season's.
